item.title: Show HN: ReadKinetic – a free, local-first speed reader for your own books
Show HN: A new kind of FPS aim trainer
item.description:
📝 Anonymous drill summaries are contributed by default to train the shared, science-based player model everyone starts from and that renormalizes your ratings to real peers. Settings that change the meaning of telemetry (FOV, sens, target style, crosshair, invert, capture level) are recorded in each replay's. Every number here is explained.
🔗 Read more: https://openaim.pramit.gg/
